title: Research the python.org Windows installer's options and checksums
goal: The kb states, from python.org and docs.python.org, the Windows installer's unattended options the script uses (InstallAllUsers, PrependPath, Include_launcher, InstallLauncherAllUsers, Include_test, Shortcuts, /quiet), where a per-user install goes, that the installer ships no python3.exe, and how the release API publishes each file's SHA-256 and Sigstore bundle.

run: python.org Windows installer PrependPath InstallAllUsers quiet

notes: Sources: https://docs.python.org/3/using/windows.html (installing without UI) and https://www.python.org/api/v2/downloads/release_file/ (sha256_sum, sigstore_bundle_file per file). Work it with /kb-research.

run: python.org Windows installer PrependPath InstallAllUsers quiet
